About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

  • Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

  • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

  • Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

  • Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

  • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Call with Head of Product: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round: A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

 

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

title: Senior Security Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
WHO WE ARE

We prioritise privacy as a fundamental right, delivering the most secure communication experience across various industries. Our cutting-edge encryption technology and robust security measures have made us a trusted partner in the technology, finance, healthcare, and government sectors. If you are passionate about redefining secure communication and want to be part of an innovative team, join us as a Senior Product Manager within our Product Engineering organisation. Together, let us build a world where privacy and security shape the future of communication.


GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Employment Type: 12-month contract with the possibility of extension

  • Previous working experience: 5-7 years in Product Security

  • Working hours: 40hrs/week

  • Working Location: Remote EU / Berlin

  • Desired start date: As soon as possible


YOUR CHALLENGE AT WIRE

Be ready to play an essential role by joining our Information Security Team. You will become a pioneer in transforming how organisations and governments communicate securely. You will work closely with the Director of Information Security and interact with the engineering, product, and other teams regularly. Your areas of work are:

Product Security

  • You review security- or privacy-critical changes and implement or propose solutions to potential issues

  • You help to maintain security documentation of the product with focus on product certifications

  • You communicate with internal and external stakeholders regarding product security topics

  • You support new feature development from a security point of view to identify possible security or privacy pitfalls early in the process

  • You contribute to internal security audits, risk assessments and threat modelling workshops

  • You conduct security awareness trainings regarding your field of responsibility

Platform  Security

  • You are responsible for our Platform Security controls

  • You support technical due diligence to ensure compliance with information security and data protection requirements 

  • You oversee the incident management process and team members involved in resolving the incident

  • You help to maintain documentation of security- and privacy-related processes

  • You support Wire’s identity and access management

  • You drive the implementation and maintenance of SecOps measures for our Platform


YOUR PROFILE

Essential requirements

  • Proficient understanding of secure software development practices, including threat modelling and security architecture review for products.

  • Hands-on experience assessing security and privacy risks in product features (e.g., authentication, encryption, data handling, APIs).

  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals (e.g., AWS) and common infrastructure tools (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm).

  • Experience supporting security certifications/compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR).

  • Strong communication skills and experience engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders on security and privacy topics.

Strong plus

  • Ideally, you have relevant security and/or DevOps certifications, such as CKS, etc.

  • You are familiar with GitHub, Jira and Confluence.

Further qualifications and skills

  • You are a good communicator and you like to work in a team.

  • You are interested in and keep up with trends and news from the InfoSec world.

  • You are self-motivated to identify security problems and engage with teams to find solutions.

  • You like to do in-depth research on your own and present the results to the team.

  • You have programming experience, preferably with one or more of JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Rust and Haskell.

  • You have a thorough understanding of security code reviews, bug triage based on common metrics like CVSS, and vulnerability management.

  • You have a practical, working understanding of basic cryptographic ciphers/algorithms and understand protocols or concepts like Elliptic Curve, TLS, Public Key Infrastructure and Messaging Layer Security.

  • You have a strong understanding of application security frameworks like OWASP Top 10.

  • You bring thorough knowledge of OAuth, SSO, Identity and Access Management systems.

  • You are willing to subject yourself to the S2 security check of the German Government.

This role can be performed remotely from Germany or another EU country. Regular travel to our Berlin office for workshops, and selected in-person collaboration sessions is expected.


WHY WIRE?

  • Join a market-proven company with more than 1,000 customers and help Wire become the trusted secure communications partner for organisations that care deeply about security and privacy.
  • Participate in Wire’s long-term success through VSOPs.
  • 30 days of vacation entitlement, allowing you to take well-deserved time off and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • With an Urban Sports Club subscription, stay balanced and mentally and physically healthy.
  • Investment in professional development with an annual education budget of €1,000 and access to top-notch learning resources.
  • Work from a beautiful office in the heart of Berlin or choose a mix of working from anywhere vs. spending selected days together in our office to connect on a personal level.
  • Enjoy fresh breakfast in the office, daily fruits, snacks, free soft drinks, and a nice Barista coffee machine.
  • Wire is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability or race.


CONTACT

Join us in shaping the future of secure communication. Click Apply now to submit your CV - we look forward to meeting you!

IMPORTANT NOTE ON RECRUITMENT FRAUD

All Wire vacancies are published on our official careers page, and every application for this position runs through Personio, our official application portal. For permanent roles we do not work with external recruitment agencies. At no point in the process will Wire, or any partner working on our behalf, ask you for payments, fees or bank details, and we never extend an offer without at least one live conversation with people from Wire. If someone contacts you claiming to represent Wire and you are unsure whether it is genuine, please get in touch with us via the support page on wire.com before you reply or share any personal data. We will check whether the contact is genuine.

  • Building the market: you build living24.uk's partner portfolio – from first contact through pitch and negotiation to the signed contract. Your targets are UK online retailers in furniture, home furnishings, garden, décor, white goods, home electronics and small appliances.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your mission

Build the backbone of intelligent energy systems.
You'll develop backend systems that turn complex optimization algorithms into reliable, real-time decisions for industrial energy systems.
From the core APIs of our optimization platform to integrations with energy management systems, you make sure our platform runs fast, stable and reliable. Your work lets our customers intelligently control and optimize battery storage, photovoltaic systems, charging infrastructure and other energy assets.
This isn't a job building standard CRUD applications. You'll work on the technological core of our product, where architecture decisions directly shape performance, scalability and the success of our solution.

Develop backend systems
You'll design, build and improve the central services of our optimization platform. You'll work on core APIs, orchestration logic and the interfaces between our systems, always aiming for robust, high-performing and maintainable solutions.

Own APIs and integrations
You'll integrate external energy management systems (EMS), partner solutions and customer systems. You'll build clean, well-documented APIs and handle the problems that come up in real-world use, such as incomplete data, retry mechanisms and outages of individual systems.

Help shape infrastructure and operations
You take responsibility for keeping our services reliable in production. From CI/CD and our cloud infrastructure (Heroku / AWS) to monitoring, alerting and performance tuning, you keep everything running smoothly.

Make systems scalable
You design systems from the start to grow with our customers. You spot bottlenecks early, improve observability, and keep our platform stable and fast as complexity grows.

Deliver features end to end
You'll work in a small, cross-functional team with a strong on-site focus. You'll own features through the whole development process, from the first idea through design and implementation to deployment and monitoring.

Raise the technical bar
You bring your experience to the table and set high technical standards. You help shape architecture decisions, share knowledge with the team, and help backend engineering at EnopAI keep getting better.


Your profile

  • At least 7 years of experience building and running production backend systems.
  • Excellent Python skills and solid experience with FastAPI, asyncio, relational databases and frameworks such as SQLAlchemy.
  • AI-first mindset: you use AI and AI agents as a normal part of your daily development work to speed up boilerplate, tests and refactoring, so you have more time for architecture, product and hard technical problems.
  • Cloud and DevOps experience: you're confident working in cloud environments and familiar with CI/CD, infrastructure as code and running modern backend systems.
  • A strong sense for architecture. You build solutions that work reliably today and still scale tomorrow, and you know when pragmatism matters more than perfection.
  • Founder mindset: you take ownership, think like an entrepreneur and make technical decisions proactively instead of just implementing requirements.
  • You enjoy working with strong engineers, give constructive feedback and hold your own work and the team's to a high standard.
  • You value the pace of a small team and like working on-site in Munich, because fast decisions and close collaboration make a real difference to you.
  • You speak fluent, business-level German and English.

    Nice to have
    • Experience with InfluxDB or other time-series databases.
    • Interest in energy systems, optimization algorithms or mathematical models.


Why us?

  • The pace of an ambitious startup where your ideas count and you have real influence on product and technology.
  • A competitive salary plus extra benefits such as the EGYM Wellpass.
  • The chance to make a concrete contribution to the energy transition through your work.
  • A central office right at Goetheplatz in Munich, with the option to work from home by arrangement.
  • An environment where you keep growing: together with a strong engineering team, you'll build innovative software, solve challenging technical problems and help shape the future of intelligent energy systems.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description:
Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren.

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.

  • Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen.

  • Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.

  • Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen.

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across nine countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that define premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution.

The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you!

Your role

As Senior Operations Manager DACH, you will initially focus on Germany and Switzerland while helping shape the future of operations across the wider DACH region, including Austria as the organisation expands. Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly.

You will have significant ownership of how operations are run in Germany and Switzerland. As the key operational point of contact for German, Swiss and future Austrian stations, you will work closely with country and central teams, as well as contractors and service providers. Your scope spans preventive maintenance of chargers and stations, station appearance and amenities, reactive maintenance, spare parts logistics, and the continuous improvement of our operations and processes. Within the broader direction set by Fastned, you will define priorities, improve the operating model and make pragmatic decisions that keep the region performing as the network grows.

Your responsibilities

Team leadership

Lead and grow the DACH field team.

  • Supervising, coaching and developing a team of five Field Engineers and a Station Manager, with a Maintenance Coordinator joining over time, ensuring they work safely, efficiently and as one strong team.

  • Managing team capacity, prioritising work and dispatching jobs in the most efficient way across the Swiss and German network.

  • Bringing structure to the team’s priorities and ways of working, helping ensure maintenance work is completed on time and the network remains safe, reliable and available for our customers.

  • Creating a strong safety culture by ensuring full compliance with Health & Safety standards and regulatory requirements, and providing a safe and caring work environment for colleagues on the road and on site.

Operational excellence

Ensure high uptime and a great station experience.

  • Being accountable for all day-to-day operations of Fastned stations in the DACH region, from chargers and systems to the overall look and feel of our sites.

  • Ensuring we maintain network uptime above 99% in your region through effective preventive maintenance plans and swift, high-quality reactive repairs.

  • Managing a network of partners responsible for maintaining and servicing our stations.

  • Supporting improvements to the customer experience and your team in the field by regularly visiting stations, performing site inspections and quality audits, with a strong focus on safety and customer experience.

  • Overseeing the handover of new stations in the DACH region from Construction to Field Operations, ensuring they meet our operational, safety and quality standards from day one.

  • Managing spare parts flows together with our Supply Chain team to optimise local stock levels, minimise downtime and ensure that engineers always have the right parts at the right time.

  • Leading and coordinating with external partners larger infrastructure works at your stations.

  • Continuously improving how we work by taking local initiatives, standardising best practices, simplifying processes and using data and insights to make better decisions.

Customer, stakeholder and partner management

  • Delivering a best-in-class customer experience by ensuring stations are always clean, safe and easy to use, with strong attention to detail across lighting, signage, landscaping, cleanliness and amenities.

  • Collaborating closely with Customer Operations and other internal teams to monitor performance, respond to incidents and ensure a smooth, end-to-end customer journey across the network.

  • Acting as the voice of DACH Operations within the leadership team and central organisations, representing operational priorities and insights.

  • Initiating, developing and maintaining strong relationships with external partners and contractors, such as electrical contractors, cleaning, landscaping and civil works providers. Providing operational input into new station designs, upgrades and local initiatives to ensure operational excellence is embedded from the outset.

You will report to our Director of Operations, based in Amsterdam. The role is based in Germany and involves regular travel across the DACH region to visit stations and team members, as well as occasional travel to our Amsterdam headquarters.

Who are we looking for?

You are a seasoned field operations leader who can both set direction and get things done on the ground. You combine a strategic mindset with strong operational experience, and you are excited to scale and professionalise Fastned’s German and Swiss operations. You think in terms of network performance, customer experience and long-term capabilities, while also being comfortable jumping into the details when needed to remove blockers for your team.

In addition, you meet most of the following criteria:

  • You have at least eight years of relevant experience in operations roles.

  • You have proven experience scaling or professionalising operations in a growing market, for example by building teams, introducing new ways of working, improving performance and enhancing customer experience.

  • You are a strong people leader who coaches and develops your team, communicates clearly and stands your ground when needed, leads by example in the field, and creates a safe, high-performance culture.

  • You combine a strategic mindset, including the ability to set a vision for DACH Operations, define priorities and align stakeholders, with hands-on senior operational experience. You are comfortable going on site, understanding technical issues and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • You remain calm and organised under pressure, can manage multiple priorities at once and maintain a positive, can-do attitude.

  • You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to connect the needs of the German and Swiss operations with those of our central teams and influence decisions where needed.

  • You are fluent in English and German. Any additional European language is a plus.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we do not forget to recognise and celebrate our successes, big and small. We value work-life balance, offer real work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We have an inclusive work environment and love authentic people, so do not try to fit in because we like you for who you are!

  • A fully electric company car, with all charging expenses covered.

  • 29 days of annual leave.

  • Two Mission Days each year to support a cause you care about or contribute to our mission.

  • A company bonus plan that recognises the impact you make.

  • A Deutschlandticket covered by Fastned.

  • An annual personal development budget of €3,000, because there is always more to learn and improve.

  • Mental wellbeing support through nilo health.

  • A subsidised Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Access to women’s health experts through our partnership with Flouria.

  • A laptop and phone of your choice, with an EU-wide mobile phone plan.

  • Daily vegetarian lunches, snacks and drinks at our office locations.

  • Team events throughout the year, an annual company trip and our legendary Christmas parties.

Interested? Apply today!

We would love to have a conversation with you! Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your cover letter why you are excited about joining our mission for freedom in sustainable transportation.

We are looking forward to your application!


Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique

Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass im Arbeitsalltag technisch alles läuft?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Support & Infrastruktur bist du eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen und sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team für einen zuverlässigen IT-Betrieb. Ob Anwendersupport, Hardware, Server oder Telefonie: Du kümmerst dich darum, dass unsere IT im Tagesgeschäft funktioniert, löst technische Probleme und entwickelst dein Know-how dabei kontinuierlich weiter.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Du bist da, wenn die Technik mal nicht mitspielt: Als erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterstützt du bei Fragen und Störungen rund um Hard- und Software und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme schnell und unkompliziert gelöst werden.

  • Ein funktionierender Arbeitsplatz beginnt bei einer zuverlässigen IT: Du richtest Arbeitsplätze, Notebooks und weitere Hardware ein, betreust unsere Endgeräte und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen technisch gut ausgestattet arbeiten können.

  • Auch hinter den Kulissen muss alles laufen: Gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team betreust du unsere bestehende IT-Infrastruktur – von Servern und Netzwerken bis hin zu unserer Voice-over-IP-Telefonie – und unterstützt dabei, einen stabilen Betrieb sicherzustellen.

  • IT-Alltag bedeutet Abwechslung: Neue Mitarbeitende technisch onboarden, Berechtigungen einrichten, Hardware austauschen oder eine Störung analysieren – bei dir landen ganz unterschiedliche Themen aus unserem täglichen IT-Betrieb.

  • Nicht jedes Problem endet im 1st Level: Du analysierst technische Störungen, löst sie eigenständig, wo du kannst, und bindest bei komplexeren Fragestellungen die richtigen Kolleginnen und Kollegen oder externen Ansprechpartner ein.

  • Gute IT wird gemeinsam besser: Du dokumentierst Lösungen und wiederkehrende Fragestellungen, bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Tagesgeschäft ein und hilfst uns dabei, unsere IT-Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Deine Vorteile bei der VRT

  • Geld, Zusatzleistungen, Ausgleich: Faires Gehalt, Prämien, Zuschüsse, Rabatte, Gutscheinkarte, bezahlte Überstunden oder Freizeit-Ausgleich – bei der VRT stimmt das Gesamt-Paket, auch unterm Strich!

  • Gleitzeit, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, von Vollzeit in Teilzeit und wieder zurück – bring alles unter einen Hut, was dir am Herzen liegt!

  • Updates, Fortbildungen: Schnittstellen zu unserem DATEV-Anwendersupport, individuelle Fortbildungen u. v. m. – wir bringen dich weiter!

  • Team-Events, Sportangebote, Betriebsausflüge, Weihnachtsfeier, Karnevalsfeier, Lauf- und Fitness-Termine, Urban Sports und EGYM Wellpass, Firmenläufe u. v. m. – wir bei der VRT sind von Natur aus sehr gesellig!


  • IT ist dein Zuhause: Du hast eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich – zum Beispiel als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration – abgeschlossen oder bringst vergleichbare praktische Erfahrungen aus dem IT-Support oder der Systemadministration mit.

  • Du kennst den IT-Alltag: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung im Anwendersupport und fühlst dich in Microsoft-Umgebungen sowie im Umgang mit Hard- und Software wohl. Kenntnisse rund um Netzwerke, Server oder Voice over IP sind ein Plus – aber kein Muss.

  • Probleme wecken deinen Lösungsinstinkt: Du gehst technischen Störungen gerne auf den Grund, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Anfragen gleichzeitig auf deinem Tisch landen.

  • Service gehört für dich zur IT: Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und hast Freude daran, Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei ihren IT-Fragen weiterzuhelfen.

  • Du möchtest dich weiterentwickeln: Du musst noch nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, dein Wissen gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team kontinuierlich auszubauen.

Bewirb dich jetzt bei der VRT!

Mit rund 290 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern und 20 Partnern an unseren neun Standorten (Bad Honnef, Bonn, Euskirchen, Füssen, Gemünd, Köln, Meckenheim, Rheinbach, Siegburg) arbeiten wir jeden Tag aufs Neue an interessanten Aufgabenstellungen für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen, größere Unternehmen (MDax) sowie Existenzgründer und Privatpersonen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung, Rechtsberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

Checkout.com are actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in London to drive rapid growth for our revolutionary Card Issuing solution. We need a high-achieving individual to help global enterprises launch modern card programs—from virtual cards for travel intermediaries to physical cards for BNPL.

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge issuing solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan.

Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets.

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive.

 

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals.

The role in one line

As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll help define what strategic success looks like at incident.io, and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability.

These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You’ll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO.

title: Director of Quality
description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone

Team: Production, Quality

Reports to: VP Production

Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators

About the role

As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents. You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows.

You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content.

We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure.

What you'll do

Quality Agent leadership

  • Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions.

  • Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems.

  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths.

  • Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort.

Research and Product partnership

  • Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows.

  • Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output.

  • Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed.

Audit, compliance and procedure

  • Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits.

  • Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

  • Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work.

  • Make sure quality processes meet customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Customer advisory

  • Partner with Customer Success and Delivery to define proactive quality programmes, success metrics and governance for strategic accounts, including AI-forward enterprise and life science / regulatory programmes.

  • Translate customer quality requirements into clear pre-delivery acceptance criteria, validation methods and risk-appropriate controls.

  • Advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix and where automated, agent-verified, human-verified or combined workflows are appropriate.

  • Represent LILT's quality function as a credible subject-matter authority in customer business reviews, audits and escalations, using quality data and metrics to demonstrate fitness for purpose.

Continuous improvement

  • Lead structured CI across the Commercial business: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, KPI reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own a proactive quality metrics framework that makes errors, PQs, rework and trends visible, and use it to prioritise improvements and demonstrate outcomes.

  • Strengthen quality controls across review, delivery and follow-through, including mandatory account-specific checks, intervention on critical findings and clear escalation ownership.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to automate checks and escalation, and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence rather than ending at rework or ticket closure.

Expert Operations partnership

  • Partner with Expert Supply and Ops to embed processes, guidance and quality feedback that maintain a high-quality pipeline of experts.

  • Use quality findings and recurring failure patterns to improve expert qualification, guidance and ongoing quality management.

Team leadership

  • Lead and develop the Quality team, including the customer-facing Quality Manager and Quality Coordinators.

  • Establish the team's operating cadence and evolve how the team works as Quality Agents reduce manual coordination work.

  • Oversee embedded Quality Manager staffing sold as a service to customers, ensuring the role owns the specific quality programmes and initiatives those customers pay for.

  • Develop playbooks for AI-driven quality management and keep staffing-as-a-service delivery aligned with LILT's quality standards.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Agent design and build: demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and running LLM-based agents in production. Please be ready to walk us through agents you have built.

  • Data-driven quality management: scripting or data skills (e.g. Python, SQL), with experience turning quality data into actionable metrics, preventive controls and measurable improvements.

  • LLM model improvement: proven experience improving LLM output quality.

  • Significant experience running quality systems, including leading audits (internal and external), compliance programmes, and writing and maintaining processes and procedures. Quality certifications such as Six Sigma are a plus.

  • Experience leading structured CI (RCA, CAPA, KPI reviews).

  • Experience managing and developing people.

  • Customer advisory and cross-functional partnership: a clear communicator who can translate customer quality requirements into acceptance criteria and governance, advise on quality, cost and speed trade-offs, and work credibly with customers, executives and technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Background in localisation, translation or language services.

  • Experience in customer-facing quality roles for enterprise accounts.

  • Research and Product collaboration: a track record of working with research scientists and product managers to turn quality insight into product requirements and shipped improvements.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our ADAS Team

Wayve's ADAS engineering teams build the perception and intelligence that power driver assistance in real-world driving. We work end-to-end, from creating high-quality training data, to developing and evaluating CV/3D perception models, to iterating quickly based on performance gaps. The team mixes "online" (on-car, latency/compute constrained) and "offline" (heavier, large-scale data generation) work, with a strong focus on measurable impact and shipping.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Train, debug, and improve computer vision and 3D perception models, iterating based on clear evaluation signals

  • Work across the full ML lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, and iteration

  • Partner with the team to decide what to tackle next, based on where the system is underperforming

  • Build scalable data pipelines, including auto-labelling and pseudo-labelling, to accelerate model development

     

🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • Core ADAS perception capabilities such as detection, classification, and instance segmentation, spanning lanes, objects, traffic signs, and traffic lights

  • End-to-end approaches that let the model act on the world directly, rather than relying on a chain of hand-coded intermediate steps (lane assist without ever explicitly detecting lane lines is the kind of outcome we're after)

  • Online perception that runs fast in-car as part of our production stack

  • Offline perception work using additional inputs not viable for on-road production, including extra sensors like lidar, future frames, maps, and extra compute, to improve data quality and coverage at scale

  • Building the "data flywheel": using offline models and 3D tracking/reconstruction to auto-generate labels and accelerate iteration across perception tasks

     

👤 You should apply if:

  • Built and shipped CV-focused deep learning systems, with strong applied ML engineering rather than research-only work

  • Experience with 3D perception concepts or pipelines, such as LiDAR, multi-view geometry, tracking, or 3D reconstruction

  • Comfortable owning work end-to-end, including evaluation and large-scale dataset generation

  • Enjoy pragmatic problem-solving under real product constraints

  • Excited to improve real-world driving performance through better perception

  • Automotive domain experience is a bonus, but not a blocker if your perception background comes from elsewhere

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

📋 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews (programming and system design; 2 hours)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Hiring manager/Domain Interview; 1 hour)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

We'll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What's in it for you (Location dependent):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
